{{Quote|Choose from regular or half-caf, freshly ground and brewed. Bantha cream and Christophsian sugar available upon request.|Dex's Diner menu, on its caf|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Bantha cream''' was a type of [[Cream/Legends|cream]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with the [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that produced [[Blue milk/Legends|blue milk]].<ref name="Stay on Target">''[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|Stay on Target]]''</ref> Customers at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], could request bantha cream for their [[caf]] or [[half-caf]]<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bantha cream was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
